description: This file defines the TransactionModel class, representing a data model for transactions in a financial tracking app. It includes methods for constructing instances from database maps, converting to database maps, copying with modifications, and helper functions for date handling. The class encapsulates transaction details like id, category, amount, note, and timestamps, and provides in-memory filtering capabilities.

classes.name: TransactionModel
classes.description: A data model representing a financial transaction with properties for id, category, amount, note, and timestamp fields, along with methods for conversion to/from database maps, copying, and filtering.

methods.name: TransactionModel.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a TransactionModel instance from a map of database query results, parsing ISO 8601 date strings into epoch milliseconds.

methods.name: TransactionModel.toMap
methods.description: Converts the TransactionModel instance into a map suitable for database insertion or updating, converting epoch milliseconds back into ISO 8601 strings.

methods.name: TransactionModel.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a new TransactionModel instance with updated fields, defaulting to existing values where new ones aren't provided.

methods.name: TransactionModel.onDate
methods.description: Factory method to create a TransactionModel instance for a specific DateTime, converting it into epoch milliseconds.

methods.name: TransactionModel.isWithinRange
methods.description: Checks if the transaction date falls within a specific start and end epoch milliseconds range, for in-memory filtering.
